label: V4 ideal-direct-hit baseline
assumptions: This is a level-ground, ideal-direct-hit projection. It excludes terrain, trajectory, splash, aim error, and projectile collision.
All V4 Relics use the same 640-unit level-ground full-power range envelope derived from the authoritative fixed-point speed and gravity constants.
A turn may relocate up to the existing 64-unit V4 movement budget and then make one ideal direct cast when its selected Relic is in band.
